page.content:
2023 sibling series from the Ice King's fanfiction world.

How Fionna and Cake connects

  • Topic: Adventure Time — Fionna and Cake is a sibling series in the Adventure Time world.
  • Character: Simon Petrikov — The sibling series returns to Simon after the crown.
  • Character: Ice King — Fionna and Cake began as the Ice King's fanfiction.
  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — Fionna and Cake follows years after the original series.

What is Fionna and Cake?

Fionna and Cake takes the gender-swapped stories Ice King wrote and makes them a multiverse series, still tied to Simon Petrikov and Ooo.
